# Data Loading and Preprocessing

In this section, we load the data and perform any necessary preprocessing steps.

```{r load-data, echo=TRUE}
# Load the data
data <- read.csv("sample.csv")

# Display the first few rows of the dataset
head(data)
```

# Data Analysis

Here, we perform some basic analysis on the data.

```r
# For example, calculate the mean of a numeric column
mean_value <- mean(data$your_numeric_column, na.rm = TRUE)
mean_value
```

# Visualization

This section includes visualizations that automatically update when the data changes.

```{r plot, echo=FALSE}
library(ggplot2)



# Generate a plot
ggplot(data, aes(x = "Date", y = "Value")) +
  geom_point() +
  labs(title = "Scatter Plot of X vs Y")
```

# Conclusion

This report dynamically updates based on the data in data/your_data.csv.
